note: Each mutation is a set of exact-text edits applied to a temp copy of the target. Every edit's find text must appear exactly `count` times in the current target, or the harness fails (a mutation that did not apply proves nothing). The real file is never written. Contracts are implemented in tests/test_roster_paste_mutation_proof.py (the Node driver) and read the scrubbed samples in tests/fixtures/roster_paste/ read-only. Each mutation's caught_by lists the contract checks that must fail on it; other checks in the same contract may pass, so a narrow mutant caught by one check still counts, and every check must be named by at least one mutant.

contracts.structural_team_pos: A known player name in an ESPN roster paste counts only when the slot -> name -> team -> position sequence holds. A trap row with a slot label and a player's exact name must not match when it has no team or position line, a team line but no position line, or a position line but no team line; the 15 real roster rows still match.
contracts.duplicate_suppression: A player is matched at most once per side: matchCandidate refuses a second match with reason 'duplicate', a roster row repeated in an ESPN team paste still gives 15 unique players, and a name repeated on two lines of a plain list gives one player.
contracts.ambiguous_refusal: A name shared by two players with no team or position evidence is refused, not guessed: matchCandidate and disambiguate return no match, and a plain-list paste of the name gives zero players and an 'ambiguous' unmatched line.

slot + exact name + team line but no position line does not match
